newsitem.title: CHINA: China cuts cost of phonecalls to HK, Taiwan, Macau.
newsitem.headline: China cuts cost of phonecalls to HK, Taiwan, Macau.

text.p: China has cut the cost of long-distance telephone calls to Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan by 30 percent from July 1, an official with the Shanghai Post and Telecommunication Bureau said on Wednesday.
"It is a measure to welcome the reversion of Hong Kong to China and to meet the increasing communication demand between inland China and the three areas," he said.
The cost of calls to the three areas from the Chinese mainland, with the exception of Guangdong province, is now 8.10 yuan ($0.98) per minute, compared with 11.60 yuan before July 1, he said.
The cost of calls from Guangdong to Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan remains unchanged, he added.
